entries.final_answer: A pure sink relocation (module rename or function move with the joined segment unchanged) makes tests/architectural/untrusted_path_audit report two misleading failures — a ghost overcount and a missing-sink undercount — forcing a hand re-pin of the inventory locator columns on every relocation PR (#6642).
entries.question: What problem does this Mission solve?

entries.final_answer: A unique pure-move pairing (one ghost + one missing sink sharing (token, untrusted source)) reports a single 'moved' finding; audit --fix re-pins only file:line and qualname and the audit goes green; genuine removals, new sinks, token changes and ambiguous pairings still fail red; rationale cells carry no line-shift chains; the existing containment test module passes unchanged.
entries.question: How will we know this Mission is successful?

entries.final_answer: Out of scope: restructuring the inventory file format (issue proposal 2's split machine/human files); changing the AST matcher, seed sets or sink predicate; any change to disposition vocabulary or the seam-presence guard; touching production src/ code.
entries.question: What is explicitly out of scope for this Mission?
